findings.detail: All 14 current source hashes and 14 saved snapshots match protocol. New confirmation seed 73117 maps to actual seed 420073117; old main confirmation was 61101. Repository search found no prior trial record using new confirmation seed. This is a new synthetic draw after a version-one-informed design, not an independent new task distribution or proof of global historical seed absence.

TypedEligibility receives only four observed event-kind fields, allowing WRITE content and BRIDGE relation updates. No y, target_available, dependency or answer enters model.forward. Raw x/dt/observed still drive encoding and physical policy. All 14 shared state tensors match bitwise across Flow and diagonal for seeds 17,29,43; core-specific physical/control tensors intentionally differ.

Evaluate loops all 18 task/core/seed fits and all 10 conditions. Its quality gate requires all4>=0.95 in each of 81 nonmissing records per core (3 tasks x3 seeds x9 conditions). It is a point-score gate, not a 95% lower confidence bound. Missing is separately reported with availability masks.

Protocol declares resampling<=1e-4 and evaluator records full-time maximum errors, but retention_gates only includes all4. Preserve frozen source. independent_retention_review.py independently checks completeness, weights/checkpoint and regenerated input hashes/raw metrics, then reports quality and subdivision gates separately. Query archives permit recomputing query errors; full-time errors remain original-evaluator measurements.

CLI checks current sources before train/evaluate. Evaluation checks exact externally supplied all-candidate digest, protocol/training source identity, all18 distinct fits, checkpoint SHA and paired training stream hashes. It marks changed source false and returns failure. SHA/commit fields bind bytes; remote publication must be verified by root, not inferred from a 40-character string.

Primary all-four Flow-minus-diagonal base effects use 98.333% three-task family intervals; other effects use descriptive95% paired hierarchical bootstrap with2000 replicates and only3 training seeds. Zero-width all-success intervals are not population certainty. Train phase parent+childrenCPU and nested fitCPU must not be summed twice. Sequence latency includes conversion/predict; energy and GPU are unmeasured, and equal steps/data are not equal compute.
